status: Recording-ready Rift Keeper and seven class mentors; trial arena redesigns pending

hall.keeper.intro.text: Welcome to the Rift Hall. I keep the broken rifts here until their missing pieces return. Five matching shards make a whole. Bring them to me, and I can join them. Try not to carry them loose in a pocket. You will miss the pocket.

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Warm male voice, patient and gently amused. Dry humor on the last line.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Warm male voice, patient and gently amused. Dry humor on the last line.

hall.keeper.welcome.text: Each frame names the land where its shards fell and the fighting style it leads to. The count shows the pieces you have brought back safely. Which shall we look at?

choices.text: Can you join my saved shards?
Where did these rifts come from?
What is waiting on the other side?

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Helpful and unhurried. Explain the visible room without sounding like a tutorial announcer.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Helpful and unhurried. Explain the visible room without sounding like a tutorial announcer.

hall.keeper.assemble.text: Set your saved pieces here. I will join every complete set. If a frame still waits, read the count above it. A missing piece cannot be replaced with enthusiasm. Many have tried.

choices.text: What counts as a saved piece?

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Careful concentration, then a small smile. Do not promise a portal opened: the player may have incomplete sets.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Careful concentration, then a small smile. Do not promise a portal opened: the player may have incomplete sets.

hall.keeper.origin.text: These rifts once stood in Sunspire Palace. When the Legion took it, a scholar threw them out rather than let that fighting knowledge be lost. The fall broke them. A desperate choice, but the pieces survived.

choices.text: So the scholar saved them by breaking them?
Then we should put them back together.

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Quiet respect. Do not name the scholar or claim who first created the rifts.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Quiet respect. Do not name the scholar or claim who first created the rifts.

hall.keeper.scholar.text: Better scattered across Aerth than locked away from everyone who needs them. Now a farmer, a traveler, anyone willing to search can reach a teacher. I suspect the Legion finds that deeply annoying.

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Hopeful, with a restrained chuckle on deeply annoying. No prophecy or lineage reveal.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Hopeful, with a restrained chuckle on deeply annoying. No prophecy or lineage reveal.

hall.keeper.training.text: A teacher of that discipline waits beyond each restored rift. You prove you can use what they teach, and bring those skills back with you. Opening a rift gives you a chance to learn. It does not do the learning for you.

choices.text: Are these like the Hollow Gate?

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Clear, encouraging, lightly firm on the last sentence. These mentors are not all dead Bladeborn.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Clear, encouraging, lightly firm on the last sentence. These mentors are not all dead Bladeborn.

hall.keeper.difference.text: No. These are paths to training. The Hollow Gate is the black opening the Abyss King uses to take people from themselves. Purple crystal here. Hungry darkness there. Do not confuse the two.

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Serious but reassuring. No new explanation of how the Hollow Gate works or ending spoilers.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Serious but reassuring. No new explanation of how the Hollow Gate works or ending spoilers.

hall.keeper.saving.text: Finish the part of the level you are in to keep its shards. If you fall before that, the pieces you found in that part are lost. The pieces already saved stay yours. If a friend finds one on the ground, each of you must pick it up.

voice.speaker: riftkeeper
voice.emotion: Plain and practical. This is checkpoint guidance, not a new magical law.
voice.context: Rift Hall. The player is still an ordinary local fighter; do not imply they are Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Plain and practical. This is checkpoint guidance, not a new magical law.

trial.berserker.intro.text: You have something worth fighting for. Good. Anger gets you moving. It does not get to choose where you stop. Show me you can finish a fight without letting it own you.

voice.speaker: mentor_berserker
voice.emotion: Direct, warm male veteran. Firm rather than shouting. A dry smile on the practical warning.
voice.context: A crystalline training rift. The class unlock is granted at the exit after completing the existing trial. Do not reveal Bladeborn ancestry or claim this teacher is a dead Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Direct, warm male veteran. Firm rather than shouting. A dry smile on the practical warning.

trial.berserker.lesson.text: Keep moving between your blows. Save a heavy swing for a clear opening. Hitting harder is useful. Standing still so everyone can hit you back is less useful.

choices.text: Tell me about your approach again.

trial.ninja.intro.text: Most people watch the weapon. I watch the feet. Show me where you choose to stand, and I will know how much trouble you are about to cause.

trial.ninja.lesson.text: Move out of a warning before it becomes a hit. Strike from a clear angle, then find the next one. A quick weapon cannot make a poor position safe.

trial.reaper.intro.text: The scythe has reach. You still need judgment. Get too close, and you give that reach away. Rush every opening, and you may discover it was not an opening.

voice.speaker: mentor_reaper
voice.emotion: Low, steady male voice. Serious but not cruel; this teacher is not the Abyss King or a soul thief.
voice.context: A crystalline training rift. The class unlock is granted at the exit after completing the existing trial. Do not reveal Bladeborn ancestry or claim this teacher is a dead Bladeborn.
voice.direction: Low, steady male voice. Serious but not cruel; this teacher is not the Abyss King or a soul thief.

trial.reaper.lesson.text: Keep the fight near the edge of your reach. Watch for the enemy to commit before you swing. Power is not permission to ignore a warning.

trial.pirate.intro.text: Welcome aboard. No, there is no ship. The welcome was free, so I would not ask for a refund. Show me you can keep your feet when a fight turns messy.

trial.pirate.lesson.text: With your pistol and saber, fire while you keep your distance. Charge the saber when trouble gets close. A loaded weapon is useful. Room to use it is better.

trial.paladin.lesson.text: Watch what threatens you before you answer it. Leave room to dodge, and use your protection when a blow is coming. Holy light does not excuse bad footing.
